verdict.rationale: Kong's evidence covers gateway/proxy functionality, Dev Portal publishing of existing OpenAPI specs, and decK for declarative config sync, but nothing shows a spec-first design workflow where a developer authors an API spec in Kong and exports it as OpenAPI — Dev Portal only publishes specs, it doesn't create them. Missing for 10: an OpenAPI spec editor/design surface, evidence of authoring a new spec within Kong, and export tooling from a design-first workflow.
